name: Radiation Leveling: How It Works & Key Items

pages.text: $(li)To level Astral Sorcery perks via radiation, stand in lethal radiation; the damage probably needs to give you the wither effect. Picking up high-radiation items like Californium blocks can nuke you outright.

$(li)Carry a Charm of Life (a Totem of Undying probably works too) to survive the lethal radiation.$(li)Radiation XP gain is tick-based and requires actual damage registration; inconsistent XP may mean your damage isn’t registering reliably.
$(li)Radiation XP gain is capped per-hit, not per-second—so high-damage sources (e.g., Californium blocks) maximize XP per tick.$(li)The XP bar may $(o)appear$() stuck but is still increasing slowly.
$(li)Radiation levelling needs the constellation attunement that's about taking damage. To change attunement later, use an Irradiant Shifting Star (not the base one) attuned to the one you want.

$(li)Kikoku does $(o)not$() count as dealing damage for XP gain—use direct radiation sources instead.$(li)Lag can interfere with XP gain; minimize lag or hold the action key to ensure damage ticks register consistently.
